cumulative: cumulative SUM of monthly returns (long-short factors are zero-cost; compounding them is not meaningful)

benchmarks.note: alpha and beta are null below the minimum

trace.label: TRACE-only
trace.blurb: What a public user can reproduce end to end from the published pipeline.

extended.label: Lehman-ICE + TRACE
extended.blurb: The full 1973-> history. This is the product the website has always served.

lehman_ice.label: Lehman-ICE only
lehman_ice.blurb: The pre-TRACE half alone, fixed at 2023-01. Does not extend -- a new WRDS pull does nothing for it.

exc.long: Excess return over the one-month Treasury bill
exc.how: The bond's total return minus the one-month T-bill rate from Kenneth French's library. In a long-short factor the risk-free rate cancels, so both legs stay interpretable as zero-cost portfolios.

dur.cite_full: Andreani, M., Palhares, D. and Richardson, S. (2024). Computing corporate bond returns: a word (or two) of caution. Review of Accounting Studies 29, 3887-3906.
dur.how: CRSP fixed-term Treasury index returns interpolated at the bond's modified duration across the nodes 1/12, 1, 2, 5, 7, 10, 20 and 30 years.

dbns.long: Duration-adjusted, present-value weights on the bond's own cash flows
dbns.cite_full: van Binsbergen, J.H., Nozawa, Y. and Schwert, M. (2025). Duration-Based Valuation of Corporate Bonds. The Review of Financial Studies 38(1), 158-191. doi:10.1093/rfs/hhae054.
dbns.how: A synthetic Treasury carrying the bond's own cash flows, each weighted by its present value discounted at the bond's own yield. That yield is higher than the Treasury zero yields, so the weights sit further forward and the benchmark is shorter in duration, removing parallel shifts in the curve.
dbns.equation: w_k = PV_k / SUM_j PV_j,   PV_k = CF_k / (1 + y/f)^(f t_k)
dbns.equation_source: Eqs. (3)-(6) of the SSRN working paper 3914422, which is what code/ implements; the published RFS version may renumber.

dcls.long: Duration-adjusted, cash-flow matched on the Treasury zero curve
dcls.cite_full: Cui, S., Lu, Y. and Song, Y. (2026). Understanding Corporate Bond Excess Returns, Eqs. (3)-(6).
dcls.how: The same synthetic Treasury, but each cash flow is weighted by its present value on the Treasury zero curve rather than the bond's own yield. That is the only difference from BNS. The weights sit further out, so this benchmark is longer in duration and removes slope and curvature as well as parallel shifts.
dcls.equation: v_k = CF_k exp(-z_t(t_k) t_k) / SUM_j CF_j exp(-z_t(t_j) t_j)
dcls.equation_tex: v_k = \frac{CF_k\, e^{-z_t(t_k)\, t_k}}{\sum_j CF_j\, e^{-z_t(t_j)\, t_j}}

items.trace: Transaction prices from TRACE, cleaned and filtered as in Dickerson, Robotti and Rossetti (2026). This is the dataset a public user can reproduce end to end from the published pipeline.
items.extended: Quote-based data before August 2002, the Lehman Brothers (Warga) database from 1973 to 1997 and ICE/BofA-ML from 1997 to 2002-07, then TRACE transaction prices from August 2002 onward.
items.lehman_ice: The pre-TRACE half on its own, quote-based throughout. It is fixed and does not extend, and it sorts 83 of the 108 characteristics, because quote data carries no trade prints and no daily returns.

items.single: Bonds are ranked across the whole cross-section each month, into deciles over all bonds and quintiles inside a rating band. The factor is the top portfolio minus the bottom.
items.within_firm: Bonds are ranked only against other bonds of the same issuer, so firm-level determinants such as default risk and leverage are differenced out. Firms combine in proportion to the market value of their two legs.

rt.title: Return definition
rt.note: The four differ only in how the duration-hedged portfolio of Treasuries is built. Each one is a separate build, with the beta, momentum and reversal characteristics re-estimated against its own benchmark. Full definitions and citations are in the About tab.

band.title: Universe

items.all: Every bond in the dataset, ranked into deciles.
items.ig: Investment-grade bonds only, ranked into quintiles.
items.nig: High-yield bonds only, ranked into quintiles.

band.note: This is the formation universe. Bonds are ranked against each other inside it, rather than the factor being filtered after the sort.

items.ew: Every bond in a leg counts the same.
items.vw: Bonds count in proportion to price times amount outstanding, so large issues dominate the leg.

flip.title: Orient to positive mean
flip.text: Some factors earn a negative average return. This multiplies those by minus one so every factor reads positive, the convention most published tables use. It changes the display only. The data behind the page and in the downloads carries no correction, and a row marked with a small minus sign is the one being shown corrected. Volatility is unchanged, and maximum drawdown is measured again on the corrected path.

group.title: Group by cluster
group.text: The 108 characteristics fall into nine clusters, from spreads, value and momentum through illiquidity and volatility to the beta families. With this on, rows sit under their cluster and a column sort ranks within each one. Turn it off for a single ranking across every factor.

align.title: Aligned sample
align.text: Selected series can cover different months, because datasets start in different years and some characteristics only exist after 2002. With this on, every series is cut to the months they all have and the statistics are recomputed on that sample, so the comparison is like for like.

ami.name: Amihud Illiquidity
ami.description: Within-month mean of daily $|r_t|/\text{dvol}_t$. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

ami_v.name: Amihud Volatility
ami_v.description: Monthly standard deviation of daily Amihud ratios. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

ar_sprd.name: Abdi-Ranaldo Spread
ar_sprd.description: Closing price spread estimator. Requires a minimum of 5 prices.

b_amd.name: Amihud Beta
b_amd.description: Beta on aggregate Amihud illiquidity factor.

b_cptlt.name: Intermediary Capital Beta
b_cptlt.description: Beta on traded intermediary capital ratio.

b_credit.name: Credit Spread Level Beta
b_credit.description: Beta on BAA-AAA credit spread level.

b_crf.name: Credit Risk Beta (Univariate)
b_crf.description: Beta from univariate regression on CRF.

b_dcredit.name: Credit Spread Change Beta
b_dcredit.description: Beta on monthly changes in BAA-AAA spread.

b_defb.name: Default Beta
b_defb.description: Beta on DEFB from duration-adjusted market regression.

b_drf.name: Downside Risk Beta (Univariate)
b_drf.description: Beta from univariate regression on DRF.

b_dunc.name: Macro Uncertainty Beta
b_dunc.description: Beta on changes in Jurado, Ludvigson, and Ng (2015) macro uncertainty index.

b_dunc3.name: 3-Month Uncertainty Change Beta
b_dunc3.description: Beta on 3-month change in Jurado, Ludvigson, and Ng (2015) macro uncertainty.

b_dunc6.name: 6-Month Uncertainty Change Beta
b_dunc6.description: Beta on 6-month change in Jurado, Ludvigson, and Ng (2015) macro uncertainty.

b_duncf.name: Financial Uncertainty Beta
b_duncf.description: Beta on changes in Jurado, Ludvigson, and Ng (2015) financial uncertainty component.

b_duncr.name: Real Uncertainty Beta
b_duncr.description: Beta on changes in Jurado, Ludvigson, and Ng (2015) real uncertainty component.

b_dvix.name: VIX Innovation Beta
b_dvix.description: Sum of contemporaneous and lagged $\Delta$VIX betas from MKTB+MKTRF regression.

b_dvix_dn.name: Downside VIX Beta
b_dvix_dn.description: Beta on $\min(\Delta\text{VIX}, 0)$ from asymmetric VIX model.

b_dvix_up.name: Upside VIX Beta
b_dvix_up.description: Beta on $\max(\Delta\text{VIX}, 0)$ from asymmetric VIX model.

b_dvixd.name: Daily VIX Innovation Beta
b_dvixd.description: Beta on daily $\Delta$VIX within the month. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

b_epum.name: Monetary Policy Uncertainty Beta
b_epum.description: Beta on monetary policy uncertainty index level.

b_eput.name: Tax Policy Uncertainty Beta
b_eput.description: Beta on the tax policy uncertainty index level (Baker-Bloom-Davis categorical EPU, column "3. Taxes"). NOT trade policy -- a separate category in the same workbook, never read.

b_illiq.name: Illiquidity Beta
b_illiq.description: Beta on aggregate bond market illiquidity factor.

b_lrf.name: Liquidity Risk Beta (Univariate)
b_lrf.description: Beta from univariate regression on LRF.

b_lvl.name: Level Factor Beta
b_lvl.description: Beta on the average over key-rate U.S. Treasury yields.

b_mktb.name: Bond Market Beta (Univariate)
b_mktb.description: Beta from univariate regression on MKTB.

b_mktb_dn.name: Downside Market Beta
b_mktb_dn.description: Beta on $\min(\text{MKTB}, 0)$ from asymmetric market model.

b_mktb_mkt.name: Bond Market Beta
b_mktb_mkt.description: Beta on MKTB from joint regression with MKTRF (36-month rolling).

b_mktb_up.name: Upside Market Beta
b_mktb_up.description: Beta on $\max(\text{MKTB}, 0)$ from asymmetric market model.

b_mktbx_dcapm.name: Duration-Adj Market Beta
b_mktbx_dcapm.description: Beta on MKTBX from duration-adjusted CAPM.

b_mktrf_mkt.name: Equity Market Beta
b_mktrf_mkt.description: Beta on MKTRF from joint regression with MKTB (36-month rolling).

b_psb.name: Pastor-Stambaugh Beta
b_psb.description: Beta on bond market liquidity factor PSB.

b_rsj.name: Realized Jump Beta
b_rsj.description: Beta on aggregate realized signed jump factor.

b_rvol.name: Realized Volatility Beta
b_rvol.description: Beta on aggregate realized volatility factor.

b_term_dcapm.name: Term Premium Beta
b_term_dcapm.description: Beta on TERM $=$ MKTB $-$ MKTBX from duration-adjusted CAPM.

b_termb.name: Term Beta
b_termb.description: Beta on TERMB from market regression.

b_unc.name: Uncertainty Level Beta
b_unc.description: Beta on Jurado, Ludvigson, and Ng (2015) macro uncertainty level.

b_vix.name: VIX Level Beta
b_vix.description: Beta on VIX level from monthly regression.

bbtm.name: Bond Book-to-Market
bbtm.description: Par price divided by market price of the bond. All bonds have a par value of \$1,000 (100%).

convx.name: Convexity
convx.description: Second-order price sensitivity to yield changes. Computed with QuantLib.

cs.name: Credit Spread
cs.description: Annualized credit spread: yield minus maturity-matched U.S. Treasury yield.

cs_mu12_1.name: 12-Month Average Spread
cs_mu12_1.description: Rolling 12-month average credit spread, skipping the prior month. Requires minimum 6 observations.

cs_sprd.name: Corwin-Schultz Spread
cs_sprd.description: High-low spread estimator using two-day price ranges. Requires a minimum of 5 prices.

db_mkt.name: Daily Market Beta
db_mkt.description: Beta from within-month daily regression on cross-sectional mean return.

dcs6.name: 6-Month Spread Narrowing (log)
dcs6.description: Log change in credit spread over prior 6 months: $\log(cs_{t-6}) - \log(cs_t)$. If the spread is missing exactly 6 months ago, the nearest adjacent month is used within a $\pm$1 month band, the EARLIER month first.

dkurt.name: Daily Kurtosis
dkurt.description: Excess kurtosis of daily returns within the month.

dskew.name: Daily Skewness
dskew.description: Central skewness of daily returns within the month.

dvol.name: Daily Volatility
dvol.description: Standard deviation of daily returns within the month.

dvol_idio.name: Idiosyncratic Volatility
dvol_idio.description: Standard deviation of idiosyncratic returns (CAPMB residuals) within the month. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

dvol_sys.name: Systematic Volatility
dvol_sys.description: Standard deviation of systematic returns (CAPMB fitted values) within the month. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

es_90.name: 90% Expected Shortfall
es_90.description: Mean of worst 10% of daily returns over a 36(12) rolling window.

idimom12_1.name: Idiosyncratic Momentum (12-1)
idimom12_1.description: Sum of residuals over months $t{-}11$ to $t{-}1$ from a 36(12) rolling CAPMB regression.

idimom3_1.name: Idiosyncratic Momentum (3-1)
idimom3_1.description: Sum of residuals over months $t{-}2$ to $t{-}1$ from a 36(12) rolling CAPMB regression.

idimom6_1.name: Idiosyncratic Momentum (6-1)
idimom6_1.description: Sum of residuals over months $t{-}5$ to $t{-}1$ from a 36(12) rolling CAPMB regression (bond market factor).

ilq.name: Roll Autocovariance
ilq.description: Negative autocovariance of log returns $\times 100$. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

iltr24_3.name: Industry LTR (24-3)
iltr24_3.description: Equal-weighted average 24-3 LTR of other bonds in the same FF17 industry.

iltr30_6.name: Industry LTR (30-6)
iltr30_6.description: Equal-weighted average 30-6 LTR of other bonds in the same FF17 industry.

iltr48_12.name: Industry LTR (48-12)
iltr48_12.description: Equal-weighted average 48-12 LTR of other bonds in the same FF17 industry.

imom1.name: Industry Momentum (1)
imom1.description: Equal-weighted average prior-month return of other bonds in the same FF17 industry.

imom12_1.name: Industry Momentum (12-1)
imom12_1.description: Equal-weighted average 12-1 momentum of other bonds in the same FF17 industry.

imom3_1.name: Industry Momentum (3-1)
imom3_1.description: Equal-weighted average 3-1 momentum of other bonds in the same FF17 industry.

iskew.name: Idiosyncratic Skewness
iskew.description: Skewness of residuals from coskewness regression.

ivol_mkt.name: Idiosyncratic Volatility (MKT)
ivol_mkt.description: Residual volatility from joint MKTRF+MKTB regression.

lix.name: Negative LIX (Illiquidity)
lix.description: $-\log_{10}[(V \times P_{\text{close}}) / (P_{\text{high}} - P_{\text{low}})]$. Requires a minimum of 5 prices. Stored NEGATED (lib/illiq_pandas.py), so it rises with ILLIQUIDITY -- 99.29% of non-null values are negative, median -2.181.

ltr24_3.name: Long-Term Reversal (24-3)
ltr24_3.description: Cumulative return months $t{-}23$ to $t{-}3$. Uses expanding window starting at 12-3.

ltr30_6.name: Long-Term Reversal (30-6)
ltr30_6.description: Cumulative return months $t{-}29$ to $t{-}6$. Uses expanding window starting at 12-3, ramping to 30-6.

ltr48_12.name: Long-Term Reversal (48-12)
ltr48_12.description: Cumulative return months $t{-}47$ to $t{-}12$. Uses expanding window starting at 12-3, ramping to 48-12.

md_dur.name: Modified Duration
md_dur.description: Modified duration measuring price sensitivity to yield changes. Computed with QuantLib.

mom12_7.name: Intermediate Momentum
mom12_7.description: Cumulative return months $t{-}11$ to $t{-}7$, excluding recent returns.

mom3_1.name: 3-Month Momentum
mom3_1.description: Cumulative return months $t{-}2$ to $t{-}1$, skipping prior month.

p_fht.name: FHT Spread
p_fht.description: Spread derived from zero-return proportion: $2\sigma\Phi^{-1}((1+p_{zro})/2)$. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

p_zro.name: No-Trade Day Proportion
p_zro.description: Fraction of business days with no valid price. Returns are never inspected, so the old name "Zero-Return Proportion" contradicted this description.

pi.name: Price Impact
pi.description: Pastor-Stambaugh liquidity: negated coefficient from return reversal regression on signed volume. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

rkt.name: Realized Kurtosis
rkt.description: Within-month fourth moment of daily returns scaled by realized volatility. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

roll.name: Roll Spread
roll.description: Implicit bid-ask spread: $2\sqrt{\max(-\text{Cov}(r_t, r_{t-1}), 0)}$. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

rsj.name: Realized Signed Jump
rsj.description: Within-month asymmetry in positive vs.\ negative squared returns: $(RV^+ - RV^-)/RV$. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

rsk.name: Realized Skewness
rsk.description: Within-month third moment of daily returns scaled by realized volatility. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

rvol.name: Realized Volatility
rvol.description: Within-month square root of sum of squared daily returns: $\sqrt{\sum r_t^2}$. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns.

spd_abs.name: Absolute Bid-Ask Spread
spd_abs.description: Volume-weighted $(P^{ask} - P^{bid})$ in dollars. Requires a minimum of 5 prices.

spd_rel.name: Relative Bid-Ask Spread
spd_rel.description: Volume-weighted $(P^{ask} - P^{bid})/\text{mid}$. Requires a minimum of 5 prices.

sysmom12_1.name: Systematic Momentum (12-1)
sysmom12_1.description: Sum of fitted values over months $t{-}11$ to $t{-}1$ from a 36(12) rolling CAPMB regression.

sysmom3_1.name: Systematic Momentum (3-1)
sysmom3_1.description: Sum of fitted values over months $t{-}2$ to $t{-}1$ from a 36(12) rolling CAPMB regression.

sysmom6_1.name: Systematic Momentum (6-1)
sysmom6_1.description: Sum of fitted values over months $t{-}5$ to $t{-}1$ from a 36(12) rolling CAPMB regression (bond market factor).

sze.name: Bond Size
sze.description: Bond market capitalization: dirty price times amount outstanding (\$ millions).

val_hz.name: Value (HZ)
val_hz.description: Percentage deviation of observed credit spread from fitted ``fair'' spread: $(cs - \widehat{cs}) / \widehat{cs}$. Controls: rating, industry, maturity, spread change, callable. Fitted spread is estimated each month via cross-sectional regression; because cs is used, this signal is also exposed to microstructure noise.

val_hz_dts.name: Value (HZ, DtS-adjusted)
val_hz_dts.description: HZ value signal demeaned within duration-times-spread quintiles to control for systematic spread-duration risk.

val_ipr.name: Value (IPR)
val_ipr.description: Log-spread residual from fair-value regression: $\log(cs) - X'\hat{\beta}$. Controls: rating, industry, log duration, volatility, callable. Fitted spread is estimated each month via cross-sectional regression; because cs is used, this signal is also exposed to microstructure noise.

val_ipr_dts.name: Value (IPR, DtS-adjusted)
val_ipr_dts.description: IPR value signal demeaned within duration-times-spread quintiles.

var_90.name: 90% Value-at-Risk
var_90.description: 10th percentile loss from empirical daily return distribution over a 36(12) rolling window.

var_95.name: 95% Value-at-Risk
var_95.description: 5th percentile loss from empirical daily return distribution over a 36(12) rolling window.

vov.name: Volatility-over-Volume
vov.description: Liquidity proxy: $2.5 \times \sigma^{0.6} / \bar{V}^{0.25}$, where $\sigma$ is the volatility of daily RETURNS and $\bar{V}$ mean volume. Requires a minimum of 5 daily returns. Not the volatility OF volume.

ytm.name: Yield to Maturity
ytm.description: Annualized yield to maturity. Computed with QuantLib.
